buttons.label: Write a question directly to the AI
Make a page/text summary
buttons.prompt: Make a summary of:

buttons.label: Main points
buttons.prompt: What are the main points of this article?

buttons.label: 3-sentence summary
buttons.prompt: Summarize this page in 3 sentences.

buttons.label: Kids version
buttons.prompt: Give me a child-friendly version of this information.

buttons.label: Main conclusion
buttons.prompt: What is the main conclusion of this page?

buttons.label: What's the tone?
buttons.prompt: What tone does this page have? (objective, persuasive, emotional, etc.)

buttons.label: Main arguments
buttons.prompt: What main arguments are used on this page?

buttons.label: Identify biases
buttons.prompt: Can you identify any bias in this text?

buttons.label: Sources used
buttons.prompt: What are the sources used in this page?

buttons.label: Evaluate reliability
buttons.prompt: Is this information reliable? Why or why not?

buttons.label: Statistical data
buttons.prompt: Extract all statistical data that appears on this page.

buttons.label: Summary table
buttons.prompt: Give me a table with the most important information from this article.

buttons.label: Products mentioned
buttons.prompt: List all products that are mentioned.

buttons.label: Entities mentioned
buttons.prompt: What are the names of people/places/companies that appear here?

buttons.label: Fill form
buttons.prompt: Help me fill this form with my data.

buttons.label: How to register
buttons.prompt: How can I register here?

buttons.label: Contact info
buttons.prompt: Where is the contact information?

buttons.label: Action steps
buttons.prompt: Summarize the steps to do [specific page action].

buttons.label: To presentation
buttons.prompt: Convert this article into a slide presentation.

buttons.label: For social media
buttons.prompt: Rewrite this content for a social media post.
